anati：အနတိ （√အန်）
ရှုရှိုက်၏။ အသက်ရှု၏။
DOP: anati pr. 3 sg. [ S. aniti, anati], breathes; lives ; Dhātup 176 (ana pāṇane); Dhātum 256; Sadd 399, 21 (ana pāṇane: … ~ati ānaṃ pāṇaṃ); Pj I 124, 23 (balanti ~antī ti bālā assasitapassasitamattena jīvanti; Ee so; Be, Ce assasantī ti; Se na jānantī ti).

aṇati pr. 3 sg. [ S. Dhātup aṇati, Wg § 13:1 ], sounds; speaks ; Dhātup 114; Dhātum 169 (aṇa … sadde); Sadd 357, 7 (aṇa … kaṇa sadde: ~ati); Sv 244, 10 (brahmaṃ ~atī ti brāhmaṇo, mante sajjhāyatī ti attho) = Ps I 109, 23 .
CPD: anati , pr. 3 sg. [√an; sa. aniti], to breathe, live; 3 pl. ~anti = balanti, etymology of bālā, Pj l 124, 23 .

aṇati , pr. 3. sg . ( of √aṇ), to recite; only in the etymology of the word brāhmaṇa: brahmaṃ aṇatîti 'brāhmaṇo', mante sajjhāyatîti attho, Sv l 244, 10 = Ps l 109, 23 ; Ud-a 58, 13 ; 377, 29 ; cf. Ps lll 404, 18 (brahmaṃ āneti ≠ Pj ll 472, 21 ) & Mil Trsl. ll 26 n. 1.
